description: Run Vivado opt_design for logic-level optimization: retarget, remap (AddRemap), constant propagation, and logic restructuring. Operates BEFORE placement — modifies the synthesized netlist without changing physical layout. Use when PhysOpt (post-place) is ineffective due to pure logic-depth bottlenecks. NON-MUTATING to placement; MUTATING to netlist (cell remapping, merge, removal). SKILL_CHAIN_ACTIONS auto-chains: opt_design → place_design → route_design → report_timing_summary.

directive.description: opt_design directive. 'Explore' is safest for UltraScale+ (xcvu3p). 'AddRemap' is more aggressive (remaps LUT equations).

retarget.description: Retarget logic to equivalent primitives. Safe — does not change function.
